# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Age:** School-age (around 9-11 years old during Volumes 1–5)  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v2 c1 P46](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0046), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c18 P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), [v2 c1 P46](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0046)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v2 c26 P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v2 c1 P46](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0046)</sub>
- **Role:** School pupil  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v2 c1 P46](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0046)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony has a dark, sullen little face and black eyes that often convey a hostile or mocking expression. He is noted for his impertinent swagger and sullen countenance.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023)_

## Personality

Anthony is a sullen, rebellious, and independent boy who resists authority, particularly from female teachers whom he initially deems 'no good.' He is prone to impertinence, swaggering, and mischievous pranks, such as dropping a live mouse into Anne's desk. Despite his defiant nature, he is capable of coming to respect those who stand up to him or assert firm discipline.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P28](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0028), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P30](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0030), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050)_

## History

Anthony Pye comes to live in Avonlea as the orphan nephew of Mrs. George Pye and enters the Avonlea school. When Anne Shirley becomes the teacher, Anthony shows open contempt and hostility toward her, believing girl teachers are useless. He persistently behaves impertinently, making faces and mocking Anne. Matters come to a head when he places a live mouse in her desk, causing a disturbance. In a rare outburst of anger, Anne whippers him with a hardwood pointer until he cries. Following this punishment, Anthony's attitude toward Anne changes dramatically; he begins to respect her, offers to carry her books, and acknowledges that she is capable after all.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P46](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0046), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P28](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0028), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c11 P21](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0021), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P30](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0030), [v2 c12 P32](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0032), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_
